scenarios.prompt: I want every character in this book to track a cultivation realm. Add that as a new detail on the character type.
scenarios.prompt_source: description (no _meta.synonyms declared — R2). Its own text gives the example "add 'cultivation_realm' to the character kind"; this is that example said the way a user would say it.
scenarios.falsifier: REFUTED IF: the tool is reached but no attribute appears on the character kind in loreweave_glossary after the confirm round-trip (it mints a confirm_token and writes NOTHING at call time, so a store diff of zero with ok:true is the silent-success shape), OR the attribute lands on a different kind than 'character', OR — the R2 question — the tool is never reached at all despite the request naming exactly what its own description says it does.

args.title: The Ember Codex

scenarios.falsifier: REFUTED IF: after an approved run the outline node's title in loreweave_composition is still 'The Ember Codex', OR a SECOND node is created instead of the first being renamed (op=create where op=update was meant — this is a unified op-dispatch tool and picking the wrong op is its most likely failure), OR the node count changes at all.

scenarios.prompt: Are there any suggested entries waiting for me to review?
scenarios.prompt_source: description (no _meta.synonyms declared — R2). Its own text calls it "the triage inbox" of "AI-SUGGESTED entities awaiting review"; this asks for that without naming the tool or its jargon.

sql.statement: UPDATE glossary_entities SET tags = ARRAY['ai-suggested'], status='draft' WHERE book_id='{book_id}'

scenarios.falsifier: REFUTED IF: the reply says nothing is waiting while the store holds three entities tagged 'ai-suggested' (the exact 2026-08-13 shape — an answer of 'you haven't declared any' over a populated table), OR the store changes on this read-intent turn, OR — the R2 question — the tool is never reached despite the request being a plain-English rendering of its own description.

scenarios.prompt: I want to start tracking the factions in this world. Add Factions as a new category alongside characters and items.
